genxml.title: texture engine and texture RAM registers of the Impact graphics subsystem
genxml.doc: Texture engine and texture RAM registers and loader registers of the Impact graphics subsystem.

struct.name: TEXTURE_MODE_DRAWN
struct.doc: Texture mode for the drawn texture: component depth, filters, wrap and the no-border flag. The diagnostic's mask is 25 bits. The field positions are the client's encodings, graded per field; what the board does with each field is inferred. Bit 16 is set on every texture the client has been seen to draw with, and its meaning is unknown. Formerly texmode2.

struct.name: TEXTURE_SIZE
struct.doc: Log2 sizes of the base level and the detail level code. The diagnostic's mask is 23 bits. The client writes the width and height fields twice, in the low and high nibbles of each pair, with the same value. Formerly txsize.

struct.name: TEXTURE_MANAGER_INIT
struct.doc: Written only by the client's texture-manager initialisation. The diagnostic's mask is 26 bits. Its meaning is unknown. Formerly txtile.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOD
struct.doc: Level-of-detail clamp. The minimum level is sent as the level times 64, with six fraction bits. The diagnostic's mask is 21 bits, so bits 25 to 21 of the client's word are outside the mask and their meaning is unknown. Formerly txlod.

struct.name: TEXTURE_BORDER_COLOR_RG
struct.doc: Texture border colour, red and green, 12 bits a component, laid out like the environment colour. Formerly txbcolor_rg.

struct.name: TEXTURE_BORDER_COLOR_BA
struct.doc: Texture border colour, blue and alpha, 12 bits a component, laid out like the environment colour. Formerly txbcolor_ba.

struct.name: TEXTURE_BASE
struct.doc: Per-context base block in texture RAM. The client does not write it. The kernel's base write is inferred to land here. Formerly txbase.

struct.name: TEXTURE_RAM_CONTROL
struct.doc: Texture RAM control, 20 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Its meaning is unknown. Formerly tram_cntrl.

struct.name: MAX_PIXEL_RG
struct.doc: Maximum pixel clamp, red and green, 24 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client writes it once in its texture-manager initialisation. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: MAX_PIXEL_BA
struct.doc: Maximum pixel clamp, blue and alpha, 24 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: MULTI_DIMENSIONAL_TEXTURE_ADDRESSING
struct.doc: Multi-dimensional texture addressing, 29 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Used for volume and four-dimensional textures only. The field layout is fitted to a single volume load and is inferred. Formerly mddma_cntrl.

struct.name: TEXTURE_READ_BUFFER
struct.doc: Texture read buffer select, one bit. The client writes it together with the complement in the loader's write-buffer register. The board's use is inferred from the register name. Formerly texrbuffer.

struct.name: TEXTURE_CLAMP_SIZE
struct.doc: Clamp limits in texels: the base level's width and height without a border, shifted left by the first level. The client computes the word as the width shifted left 13 bits, OR'd with the height. The height field is 13 bits wide, so a height of 8192 reads back as zero. Formerly txclampsize.

struct.name: TEXTURE_ENGINE_RESET
struct.doc: Texture engine soft-reset strobe, 3 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client does not write it. Formerly te_reset.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LEVEL_TABLE_INDEX
struct.doc: Index into the level tables. The client writes zero before it streams a table through the indexed-write token, and advances one entry per table write. The diagnostic's mask is 5 bits. Formerly txaddr.

struct.name: TEXTURE_DETAIL_BLOCK
struct.doc: First block of the detail texture, 9 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly txdetail.

struct.name: TEXTURE_BORDER_BLOCK
struct.doc: Border block of each level, streamed through the level table with the index register. The diagnostic's mask is 9 bits. Formerly txborder.

struct.name: DETAILSCALE
struct.doc: Detail weight by level of detail: a 32-entry table of 6-bit values, filled through the indexed-write token. The client's default fills the table with 31, 31, 31, 29, 28 down to 1. The diagnostic's mask is 6 bits.

struct.name: TEXTURE_ENGINE_REVISION
struct.doc: Texture engine revision, 29 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client does not write it. The diagnostic identifies revisions by a render checksum instead, see the checksum constants below. Formerly tevers.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_WRITE_BUFFER
struct.doc: Texture loader write-buffer select, one bit. The client writes it with the complement of the read-buffer bit. Formerly tl_wbuffer.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_MODE
struct.doc: Formerly tl_mode.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_LEVEL_SPEC
struct.doc: Level being loaded: its number and its log2 width and height. The client sends the level's own size here, not the destination corners of the transfer. Formerly tl_spec.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_INDEX
struct.doc: Formerly tl_addr.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_MIPMAP_BLOCK
struct.doc: First block of a level, with a per-image flag bit. The diagnostic's mask is 9 bits. The client's copy path sends it; an ordinary load does not. Formerly tl_mipmap.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_BORDER_BLOCK
struct.doc: Border block of a level, 9 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_border.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_VIDEO_CAPTURE_START
struct.doc: Video-to-texture capture start, one bit. The client does not write it; the kernel's video path does. Formerly tl_vidcntrl.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_BASE_BLOCK
struct.doc: Base block of the texture being loaded, 8 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_base.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_COPY_WIDTH
struct.doc: Copy rectangle width for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_s_size.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_COPY_HEIGHT
struct.doc: Copy rectangle height for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_t_size.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_COPY_LEFT
struct.doc: Copy rectangle left edge for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_s_left.

struct.name: TEXTURE_LOADER_COPY_BOTTOM
struct.doc: Copy rectangle bottom edge for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Formerly tl_t_bottom.
